desc: A warm, generous teacher. Amused, entirely unembarrassed, never sly and never a villain. Delighted, a little teasing, as if he has been waiting a long time. Ends with a small chuckle.
text: You found me. Took you long enough.

desc: Brisk and practical, ticking five things off on his fingers. Even rhythm, no drama, slight lift on the last one.
text: Heart rate. Breath. Temperature. Water. Distance.

desc: Slowing right down. Direct and quiet, looking straight at the boy. The question is genuine, not rhetorical.
text: I'm asking one question. Can we keep going safely?

desc: Kind and completely without apology. He knows he is right and he is not smug about it.
text: My best judgement. I'm not trying to stop you. I'm trying to get you to the finish line.

desc: Quiet, deciding out loud. A small generous choice. Slight smile, unhurried.
text: All right. Everything's holding. Let's give him a little more.

desc: A tired factory worker at the end of a long shift. Flat, resigned, matter of fact. Not frightened and not dramatic, just finished. American accent.
